structure: Each person's measurements equal a shared bivariate stable component plus independent bivariate visit deviations. Gaussian distributions complete the generator; the requested correlations follow from the stipulated second moments without Gaussian assumptions.

parameter_provenance.basis: Biomarker population means are zero; visit deviations also have zero means.
Pearson correlation between stable X and Y components.
Pearson correlation between observed X and Y at a common visit.
Independent component and deviation variances add: 4 + 1 = 5.
Deviation covariance is 2.6 - 3.2 = -0.6. Both deviation variances are one, so their correlation is also -0.6.

parameter_provenance.value: Stable components are independent of deviation vectors; deviation vectors are independent across visits; persons are independent.
Multivariate Gaussian for the stable vector and each visit deviation vector
parameter_provenance.basis: A convenient distributional completion, not a measured fact or a requirement for identifying the requested correlations.

requested_estimands.name: change_correlation
requested_estimands.basis: Stable components cancel in changes. Independent visits imply change variances of 2 and change covariance 2 * (-0.6) = -1.2, giving -1.2 / sqrt(2 * 2) = -0.6.

requested_estimands.name: same_visit_correlation
requested_estimands.basis: Directly specified by B and reproduced at either visit by (3.2 - 0.6) / 5.

requested_estimands.name: cross_visit_correlation
requested_estimands.basis: For X_visit1 and Y_visit2, only stable components contribute covariance: 3.2. Each measurement has variance 5, giving 3.2 / 5 = 0.64.

limitations: This is an artificial mathematical population, not biomedical validation.
Gaussian shapes and higher-order distributional features are assumptions; the identified correlations do not require Gaussianity.
Generated sample correlations fluctuate around the population values. No realized-sample centering, rescaling, correlation adjustment, sorting, or rejection is used.
The supplied standardized arbitrary units imply measurement variance 5 under C, not unit variance; the generator preserves those constraints.
checks_actually_performed: Analytically verified variance and covariance decompositions and all three population correlation formulas.
Analytically checked positive definiteness: stable covariance eigenvalues are 0.8 and 7.2; visit-deviation covariance eigenvalues are 0.4 and 1.6.
Reviewed the source for seed-controlled sampling, independent person-level draws, unique integer identifiers, and the required wide-format column order.
No code execution or empirical sample checks were performed.
